sen-spa.name: sên Spa
sen-spa.description:
sên means life force, echoing the concept of Chi (Chinese), Ki (Japanese), or Prana (Sanskrit), and embodies the pursuit of balance and wellness.

Immerse yourself in a curated selection of indulgent treatments, including massages, facials, hair care, mani-pedis, scrubs, wraps, and more specialized services – all crafted with premium products and delivered by our team of skilled professionals.

At sên Spa, every experience is tailored to your individual needs, making it the perfect urban retreat for relaxation, rejuvenation, and holistic well-being.

aquatics.name: Aquatics
aquatics.description:
Our Aquatics Team is dedicated to enriching lives through swimming, offering programs for all ages – from babies and toddlers to school-age children and adults.

Our Aquatics program features SwimAmerica, a nationally recognized learn-to-swim program from the United States developed by the American Swimming Coaches Association. Using techniques inspired by world-class and Olympic swimmers, SwimAmerica follows a structured, progressive approach that helps beginners build confidence, proper technique, and strong swimming fundamentals in a safe and effective way.

Members can further enhance their experience through private lessons, holiday swim camps, intensive stroke clinics, and a variety of in-house swim meets. On weekends, the whole family can enjoy fun in the water with inflatables and play structures.

promoCards.heading: Our Aquatic Programs
promoCards.description: The Club's teaching program builds skills through simple, achievable progressions, while the Swim Team focuses on guiding junior swimmers into competitive swimming.

faq.question: How do I determine my child's swim level?
faq.answer: Book a free assessment for children over three years old by emailing aquatics@amclub.org.sg or submitting the assessment form at the Aquatics Counter. Babies and toddlers do not require assessment as levels are age-based.

faq.question: Can I enroll after the term has started?
faq.answer: Yes — enrollment is possible at any point subject to class availability. Submit an enrollment form to the Aquatics Counter and the team will respond within five working days.

faq.question: When will my child move to the next level?
faq.answer: There is no fixed duration. Once an instructor confirms the swimmer confidently completes all required skills, the Aquatics Coordinator runs a level assessment. The Spring and Fall programs also include dedicated assessment weeks.

faq.question: Will swimming lessons be held if it's raining?
faq.answer: Lessons continue during light rain but are cancelled for thunder, lightning, or extremely heavy rain. Call the Aquatics Counter at 6739-4470 (or the office at 6739-4450) thirty minutes before class to confirm.

faq.question: I missed my class. Can I attend a make-up class?
faq.answer: With nearly 900 weekly swimmers and limited resources, the Club is unable to offer make-up classes.

faq.question: What if my child is sick?
faq.answer: Present a Medical Certificate covering the missed lesson dates at the Aquatics Counter within one week, or before the end of the month. Receipts are not accepted in place of an MC.

faq.question: Are Guests able to enroll in the Starfish Swim School Program?
faq.answer: Guests may only enroll in the Aquastars program and swimming camps. Terms and conditions apply — please check with the Aquatics Counter for details.

faq.question: How do I withdraw my child from a program?
faq.answer: Submit a cancellation request at the Aquatics Counter at least two weeks before the final lesson date. Phone cancellations are not accepted.

aquatics-swimamerica.name: SwimAmerica
aquatics-swimamerica.description:
SwimAmerica is a nationally recognized learn-to-swim program from the United States, developed by the American Swimming Coaches Association. Using techniques inspired by world-class and Olympic swimmers, SwimAmerica follows a structured, progressive station-based approach that helps beginners build confidence, proper technique, and strong swimming fundamentals in a safe and effective way.

At The American Club, certified SwimAmerica coaches guide students from their very first day in the water through to advanced stroke development. Each station has clear learning goals so swimmers — and their parents — can track progress at every step.
aquatics-swimamerica.hours:
Weekday afternoons and weekend mornings.
Full schedule available from the Aquatics Office.

aquatics-swim-team.name: Swim Team
aquatics-swim-team.description:
The American Club Swim Team is for swimmers ready to take their training to the next level. Members of the team train regularly with our coaches, compete at in-house and external meets, and develop the discipline, technique, and teamwork that make competitive swimming so rewarding.

Team placement is by coach assessment. Existing SwimAmerica swimmers who have completed the foundation stations are typically the strongest candidates.
aquatics-swim-team.hours:
Multiple training sessions per week.
Schedule confirmed at registration.

aquatics-masters-swimming.name: Masters Swimming
aquatics-masters-swimming.description: Masters Swimming is designed for adult swimmers who want to keep fit, improve technique, and enjoy a structured training environment. Coaches set the workouts; participants follow at their own pace and stroke choice. Whether you are a former competitive swimmer or simply someone who wants a serious workout in the pool, you are welcome to join.
aquatics-masters-swimming.hours:
Early-morning and evening sessions during the week.
Full schedule available from the Aquatics Office.

aquatics-group-fitness-classes.name: Aquatics Group Fitness Classes
aquatics-group-fitness-classes.description: Our Aquatics Group Fitness Classes combine the resistance of water with energetic, low-impact training led by qualified instructors. These classes are easier on the joints than land-based workouts while still building strength, cardiovascular fitness, and flexibility. Open to Members of all fitness levels.
aquatics-group-fitness-classes.hours:
Weekday mornings and selected evenings.
Full schedule available from the Aquatics Office.

aquatics-infants-toddlers.name: Infant & Toddlers
aquatics-infants-toddlers.description: Our Infant & Toddlers program introduces our youngest Members to the water in a safe, parent-supported environment. The focus is on water confidence, gentle skill-building, and bonding between parent and child. Each session is led by an Aquatics instructor experienced in early-childhood teaching.
aquatics-infants-toddlers.hours:
Weekday mornings and weekends.
Full schedule available from the Aquatics Office.

gym.name: Gym
gym.description:
Whether you're a long-time fitness enthusiast or just starting your wellness journey, our team of qualified Personal Trainers and Group Fitness Instructors is here to support you.

The Gym also offers a wide range of state-of-the-art cardio and strength equipment, along with a dedicated Group Fitness Studio.

Work out independently, join a group class, or book a personal training session with a trainer of your choice.

extraSections.title: Complimentary Gym Orientation
extraSections.content: Kickstart your routine with a complimentary one-hour Gym Orientation. Our Personal Trainers will guide you through equipment use, gym safety, and proper posture and form. Open to Members aged 16 and above.

extraSections.title: TGPC (Teenage Gym Proficiency Course)

Simply present your Junior Membership card and register for this complimentary orientation with our Personal Trainer. Sign up at the Sports Counter or email sportscounter@amclub.org.sg.

pilates.name: Pilates
pilates.description:
Pilates improves posture, flexibility, strength, and endurance, making it ideal for overall fitness as well as sport-specific training such as tennis, golf, and squash.

Our Pilates program follows the Pilates Academy International (PAI) method, integrating modern exercise science, anatomy, and biomechanics for a safe and effective workout. Small class sizes ensure personalized guidance, while a full range of apparatus, including the Reformer, Cadillac, and Chair, allows us to cater to different fitness levels and individual goals without placing undue stress on the joints.

bowling-alley.name: Bowling
bowling-alley.description:
The Bowling Alley offers best-in-class awesome, anytime fun. From casual family outings, couples' night, birthday parties, Junior Members' nights and corporate events, The Bowling Alley offers entertainment that's right up your alley.

Our Brunswick bowling lanes are oiled and maintained regularly to provide the best experience. For those who want a colorful twist to their usual games, the Cosmic Bowling feature provides multi-colored disco lights and catchy beats. The state-of-the-art LED lights and pin deck glow lighting feature are sure to impress your friends and family.
